continuity_scope: A deliberately small anthology sample of two separate numbered-game continuities, never a single Final Fantasy canon: (1) FINAL FANTASY X as presented on Square Enix's current official title page; and (2) FINAL FANTASY XVI base-game character material on Square Enix's official title and character pages. FINAL FANTASY X-2, FINAL FANTASY XVI DLC, remakes/remasters, prequels, sequels, crossover games, Final Fantasy Tactics (SRC-130), Final Fantasy XIV (SRC-131), and all other numbered titles are excluded unless separately researched.

work_or_witnesses.edition: Square Enix FINAL FANTASY PORTAL SITE title-page witness, English (UK), accessed 5 August 2026; base-game story and character presentation.
Square Enix FINAL FANTASY PORTAL SITE title-page witness, English (US), accessed 5 August 2026; base-game presentation.
Square Enix official character page, English, accessed 5 August 2026; base-game profiles, with DLC separately navigated and excluded.

coverage_rule: For FINAL FANTASY X, include the title page's named central pilgrimage pair, Tidus and Yuna. For FINAL FANTASY XVI, include the official character page's named Rosfield-household trio, Clive Rosfield, Joshua Rosfield, and Jill Warrick. Include only same-title relationships directly stated by those pages. Jobs/classes, summons/Eikons, crystals, races/peoples, equipment, worlds, religions, factions, and mechanics are dimensions or source terms unless a cited source presents a named person. This five-record pass is complete only for the declared two-title, five-character sample.
omissions: All other Final Fantasy numbered games and their separate settings, casts, timelines, remakes, localizations, adaptations, sequels, prequels, and crossovers
All other named characters on the cited FINAL FANTASY X and XVI pages, including Wakka, Lulu, Kimahri, Auron, Rikku, Seymour, Jecht, Torgal, Cidolfus, Benedikta, Hugo, Dion, and Barnabas
FINAL FANTASY X-2, the FINAL FANTASY XVI DLC stories, and post-release/alternate game modes
Final Fantasy Tactics (SRC-130) and Final Fantasy XIV (SRC-131), which have separate corpus records
Jobs, classes, summons/Eikons, crystals, peoples, equipment, locations, religions, factions, and generic player/mechanical constructs as graph nodes
uncertainties: The portal pages are official current title presentations, not complete in-game scripts, full codices, or exhaustive version histories. Claims are limited to their character/profile text.
FINAL FANTASY X and FINAL FANTASY XVI use different worlds and ontologies. Repeated franchise vocabulary must not create a cross-title character relationship or imply shared mechanics.

Localized spellings, voice casts, titles, and presentation may differ between language releases and remasters. This pass retains the cited English names and does not equate other editions without independent evidence.
The official XVI character page includes DLC navigation but the declared witness is its base-game character-profile content; no DLC plot or character claim is made.
evidence_basis: First-party Square Enix title and character pages only. The X page directly describes Tidus and Yuna's pilgrimage and respective roles. The XVI pages directly describe the Rosfield siblings, Jill's household upbringing, Dominants/Eikons, Bearers, and Mothercrystals. These sources establish a bounded comparison sample, not an anthology-wide canon.

supports: FINAL FANTASY X's named central pair, their pilgrimage, and the setting's guardian/summoner and Sin terminology.
